command: import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("evidence"); a=json.loads((p/"assessment.json").read_text()); assert a["status"] == "completed_with_qualifications"; assert all(c["status"]=="completed" and not c["pendingChildren"] for c in a["children"]); assert (p/"report.md").read_text().endswith("mutation.\n"); print(json.dumps({"assessment":a["status"],"performance":a["performance"],"children":a["children"],"report_bytes":(p/"report.md").stat().st_size},indent=2))
